question:
Five men A, B, C, D and E are married to five women P, Q, R, S and T (not necessarily in the same order). These men like shirts of five different colours, viz. red, green, black, yellow and pink (not necessarily in the same order). One man is married to only one woman and likes only one shirt. No two men are married to the same woman and like the same shirt. C is married to P and does not like black shirt. D likes pink shirt. R is married to E. E does not like green and black shirts. A likes green shirt but is not married to Q or T. B is not married to T. 

Which of the following combinations of man, woman and shirt colour is correct?
solution:
As per the given information:

C is married to P and does not like black shirt.

D likes pink shirt.
